import base64, io
from datetime import date
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from PIL import Image

# ── obviously synthetic data; no real records involved ─────────────
months = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun"]
values = [412, 468, 455, 512, 604, 588]
labels = ["Region A", "Region B", "Region C", "Region D", "Other"]
shares = [31.4, 26.8, 18.2, 13.9, 9.7]

C1, INK, SOFT, RULE = "#0072b2", "#1f2933", "#52606d", "#d7dce1"

def make_chart(x, y, horizontal=False, figsize=(7.2, 3.2)):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize, dpi=160)
    if horizontal:
        ax.barh(x[::-1], y[::-1], color=C1, height=.68)
    else:
        ax.bar(x, y, color=C1, width=.62)
    ax.margins(x=.02, y=.14)
    for s in ("top", "right", "left"):
        ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["bottom"].set_color(RULE)
    ax.tick_params(colors=SOFT, labelsize=8, length=0)
    ax.grid(axis="y" if not horizontal else "x", color=RULE, lw=.6, alpha=.7)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    fig.tight_layout()
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    fig.savefig(buf, format="png", transparent=False, facecolor="white")
    plt.close(fig)

    # ── metadata pass: re-encode through PIL, drop all chunks ─────
    buf.seek(0)
    im = Image.open(buf).convert("RGB")
    clean = io.BytesIO()
    im.save(clean, format="PNG", optimize=True, pnginfo=None)
    return base64.b64encode(clean.getvalue()).decode()

ch_trend = make_chart(months, values)
ch_comp  = make_chart(labels, shares, horizontal=True)

def png_chunks(b64):
    b, i, out = base64.b64decode(b64), 8, []
    while i < len(b):
        ln = int.from_bytes(b[i:i+4], "big")
        typ = b[i+4:i+8].decode("latin-1")
        if typ in ("tEXt", "iTXt", "zTXt", "eXIf", "tIME"):
            out.append(typ)
        i += 12 + ln
        if typ == "IEND":
            break
    return out or ["<none>"]

print("trend chart metadata chunks :", png_chunks(ch_trend))
print("comp  chart metadata chunks :", png_chunks(ch_comp))
print("chart payload (KB each)     :",
      round(len(ch_trend)/1024, 1), "/", round(len(ch_comp)/1024, 1))
